title: Paper accepted at HASP 2025
description: Our paper on Real-Time Bit-Flip Protection for Deep Neural Networks on GPUs has been accepted at Hardware and Architectural Support for Security and Privacy [HASP 2025](https://haspworkshop.org/2025/), co-located with [MICRO 2025](https://www.microarch.org/micro58/).

title: Paper accepted at SPICE 2025
description: Our paper on Position-Adaptive Temporal Sparsity for KV Caches in Long-Context LLMs has been accepted at [SPICE 2025](https://spice.cs.umd.edu/), co-located with [MICRO 2025](https://www.microarch.org/micro58/).

title: Joined the Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy
description: I joined the Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy as a Research Intern, where I am working on an FPGA-based fault-injection framework to evaluate the security of hardened cores. I am working in [Dr. Christof Paar's](https://www.mpi-sp.org/paar) research group.
